entries.summary: Head of the aristocratic Eldrich family business dynasty and of Eldrich Corporation, successor to the Eldrich Colonial Shipping Corporation. The richest citizen of Ukweli and a globally dominant shipping magnate: an extremely eccentric, flamboyant publicity seeker, serial inventor and promoter of improbable products, some genuinely original and others arguably stolen or appropriated. Publicly meddles in politics, funds the Libertarian party and sympathetic media, and is obsessed with colonising Mars — a colonisation effort that discovered ancient ruins on Mars, which he is furious to see unsettled by stargates and anomalous transport.

tags.value: libertarian anti-establishment branding over aristocratic pedigree
serial invention and promotion of improbable products
Eldrich Corporation (global shipping)
Eldrich Mansion on Eldrich Island
colonise Mars
patron of the Libertarian party, which stays formally autonomous

observable_facts: Heads the Eldrich Corporation, successor to the Eldrich Colonial Shipping Corporation
Publicly funds the Libertarian party and sympathetic media
His colonisation effort discovered ancient ruins on Mars
inferences: That the party is his instrument, although it remains formally autonomous
That wealth decides the argument, which the free-market rhetoric denies
The legal and physical relation of Eldrich Island to the Freedom Colony is unresolved: leave it unfilled

entries.gm_notes: His authored secret is the author's to write. Play the contradictions, not a villain: aristocratic pedigree against anti-establishment branding, monopolistic market power against free-market rhetoric, local philanthropy and jobs against elite capture. He is neither one-dimensional nor omnipotent.
